<entry id="Q00444">
<head-word>פָּחַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to breathe, pant</italic>,] 
<italic>to fear; to be anxious</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Esth. R. to V, 1 למה תִפְחְדִי why art thou afraid? Midr. Till. to Ps. XIV שלא פָחֲדוּ מן וכ' that they were not afraid of the Lord; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִפְחָד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be frightened, excited</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Esth. R. to IV, 15 היתה אסתר נִפְחֶדֶת מאוד וכ' Esther was greatly excited on account of the evil &c. Cant. R. to III, 8 מתיראין ומזדעזעין ונִפְחָדִין afraid, trembling, and excited; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִפְחִיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to frighten</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 16 כשמבקשין להַפְחִידוֹ when they want to frighten the child, v. רְצוּעָה; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פִּיחֵד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. מְפוּחָד; 
<plural-form>pl. מְפוּחָדִים</plural-form>. Sifra B’har, Par. 3, ch. IV (ref. to Lev. XXV, 19) לא מפוזרים ולא מפ' neither scattered, nor frightened.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְפַּחֵד, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְפַּחֵד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be afraid; to be joyously excited; to await with anxiety</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 15 ולא היו מתיראים ולא מִתְפַּחֲדִים and they were neither afraid, nor excited; Yalk. Ps. 795. Deut. R. s. 1, end מתייראין ומִתְפַּחֲדִין מכם trembled and were afraid of you. Ab. d’R. N. ch. IX שיהא לבו של־אדם מִתְפַּחֵד וכ' that a man’s heart should be afraid (of an evil occurrence) every day. Gen. R. s. 48 זה מִתְפַּחֵד לומר איזו פרוקופי וכ' the one is excited thinking what the distinction will be which the king is to confer upon me; וזה מתפ' ואומר איזה דין וכ' and the other is excited thinking what the judgment will be &c.; Yalk. Is. 304. Tanḥ. Lekh 15 אתם מתפחדין על הטוב וכ' you will be excited with joy over the good which is reserved for you (ref. to ופחדו, Hos. III, 5). Cant. R. l. c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="Q00446">

<notes> Esth. R. to IV, 6 פ' ורעד fear and trembling. Yalk. Ex. 181 נפל פַּחְדָּם עליהם the dread of them fell upon them. Gitt. 70

<entry id="Q00456">
<head-word>פָּחוּת</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּחַת) [
<italic>diminished</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a small quantity</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Dem. I, 21
<sup>d</sup> bot. פְּחוּת מאכל (not מאוכל) a small quantity of food (corresp. to ib. I, 2 מעוטו).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (adj. a. adv.) 
<italic>lesser, less</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. XI, 9 אין פ' משנים no less than two days (after being baked); ib. אין פ' מתשעה ולא יתר וכ' no less than nine days, nor more than eleven; Pes. 47
<sup>a</sup> לא פ' ולא יותר no less (than nine), nor more (than eleven). Meg. 21
<sup>b</sup> אין משיירין בפרשה פ' וכ' in distributing the readings of a Scriptural portion we must leave for the last reader no less than three verses; a. v. fr.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. פְּחוּתָה. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 1 ערבה שהיא פ' וכ' a kneading trough which contains less than &c.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּחוּתוֹת</plural-form>. Keth. I, 2 פ' מבנות שלש וכ' when they were less than three years and one day old; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>inferior</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. T’rum. 7 נחשת כנגד … שהיא פ' מכולם ‘copper’ (Ex. XXV, 3) corresponding to the Greek (Syrian) empire, which was the meanest of all of them; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup>. Sabb. II, 5 ר' יוסי פוטר בכלן וכ' R. J. declares (him that did it) free from punishment or eventual sacrifice in all those cases, except &c. Ker. IV, 2 ר' יהושע פוטר R. J. absolves him from bringing a sin-offering, opp. מחייב חטאת. Snh. V, 5 אם מצאו לו זכות פְּטָרוּהוּ if they found evidence in his favor, they (the court) acquitted him; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to cause exemption; to cover, include</italic>. Ber. <italic>yabam</italic> for marriage or discharge); a. fr.—Part. pass. פָּטוּר; f. פְּטוּרָה; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּטוּרִים, פְּטוּרִין; פְּטוּרוֹת</plural-form> (
<italic>is, are</italic>) 
<italic>exempt, free</italic>, opp. חַיָּיב. Peah I, 6 ופ' מן המעשרות וכ' and he need not give the tithes, until &c. B. Mets. VIII, 1 פ' (sub. מלשלם) he is free from indemnity. Ib. VII, 10 מתנה … להיות פ' משבועה may have an agreement to be eventually exempt from making oath; להיות פ' מלשלם to be exempt from responsibility. Kidd. I, 7 כל מצות הבן על האב … ונשים פ' to all paternal duties men are bound, but women (mothers) are exempt from them. Yeb. I, 2 כשם שבתו פ' כך צרתה פ' as well as his (the
